roof.surfaceEquation: topY(x)=ridgeY-(ridgeY-hipEndTopY)*ss(hipStartsX, halfWidth, |x|); y=topY-(topY-eaveY)*drop(t)+lift_total(x)*(drop(t)-drop(0.65))/(1-drop(0.65)); lift_total=cornerLift*ss(6.2,7.8,|x|)^2; ramp is 0 at t=0.65, full at the eave; lift_total < (1-drop(0.65))*(topY-eaveY) everywhere so the surface is monotone ridge->eave by construction; ridge never lifts
roof.note: ONE continuous wide slope both directions; NOT the shanmen three-band roof, NOT a low shed; gable ends closed under the wing-tip edges
